children: RNS Number : 8634X  Edinburgh Investment Trust PLC  06 October 2026

The Board announces that, with effect from 6 October 2026, a new £25 million multicurrency Revolving Credit Facility (the ‘Facility’) has been agreed with the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited, London Branch. The Facility’s maturity date is 5 October 2027.

The Facility provides an additional flexible source of gearing alongside the Company’s four existing unsecured senior loan notes, which have an aggregate par value of £120m and a blended average of 21 years to maturity.

At 30 September 2026 the portfolio’s net gearing (with debt at par) was 10.1% and net gearing (with debt at fair value) was 4.5%. The Facility, if fully drawn, would represent an additional 2.4% of gearing at par and 2.3% at fair value.
